concerns.text: Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Plan 'Data Hygiene' section mandate checksumming all files in `data/` and recording in `state/`. Tasks T006a and T006b (implementing `src/data_hygiene.py` and `data-hygiene.sh`) are marked as unchecked/missing. No other task covers this requirement, leaving the project unable to satisfy the Data Hygiene principle.

Constitution Principle VII and Plan 'Memory Enforcement' require profiling artifacts (wall-clock, memory) for *every* resolution level, stored in `data/profiling/`. Task T008 only implements abort-on-error logging to `memory_error.log`. There is no task to record successful profiling metrics per resolution, violating the requirement to capture performance profiles for the final analysis.

Success Criterion SC-001 requires calculating detection probability with 'Confidence intervals calculated via bootstrapping' to verify monotonic decline. Tasks T030 (detection probability) and T031a (t-tests) do not mention bootstrapping or CI calculation. No task exists to implement the bootstrapping procedure required by SC-001.

Success Criterion SC-002 requires identifying 'knee' points via logistic regression or linear interpolation. Task T032 contains an explicit `[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]` placeholder regarding the fallback logic and does not define the implementation path for the linear interpolation fallback, leaving the success criterion unfulfillable as written.

Plan 'Statistical Rigor' and SC-001/SC-005 require statistical tests to be performed within 'SNR bins' (stratification). Task T034 (stratified analysis) is marked with an `[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]` placeholder and lacks a defined implementation strategy, creating a gap in how the required stratified statistical tests will be executed.

Tasks T013 and T014 (down-sampling implementation and pipeline logic) are marked as unchecked/missing. While T015 references T013, the absence of the core down-sampling tasks means the anti-aliasing filter application and subsequent validation (SC-004) cannot be executed. This is a missing task for FR-002 and SC-004.
